calls.title: World Vision + GrowthBook
calls.summary: World Vision's experimentation program is in its early stages, currently launching tests every four to six weeks, with an aim to expedite this to at least one experiment per month. A key challenge is the limited availability of full stack developers, causing a backlog of 12 to 15 experiments. Cultural barriers and cautious business partners are further hindering rapid experimentation. The contract with current platform Optimizely is due for renewal in October, leading to an evaluation of alternative platforms like Growth Book, which offers better alignment with developer needs, robust CI/CD support, and data ownership. The team is pursuing a modular experimentation strategy to support their evolving technology stack while fostering a culture of rapid, data-driven decision-making.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, GrowthBook, Optimizely, Data Warehouse, CICD, Feature Flags
